# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 112 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 112 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_112_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 10, Chapter 2

**1** "But when the tower is completed — what then?" I asked. **2** "Ask that too," he said. "When the tower is finished, then comes the end." **3** "And when will the testing of the righteous occur?" "It shall be always; for it has been appointed for them by the Lord God." **4** "Lord," I said, "is there hope for those who were rejected from the tower?" **5** "There is," he said, "but this is their penance: they shall dwell near the tower and be wept over and afflicted; and if they do not repent, they shall be handed over entirely to the women who carry the black garments, and they shall be tormented by them." **6** "But if they repent — will they then enter the tower?" **7** "Not before the tower is completed," he answered. **8** "But I want to know how the tower will be completed," I said. **9** "When the Lord judges all things and no more unrighteousness is found in the chosen people of God — then the tower shall be complete." **10** "Lord, when will this be?" I asked. "It will be," he said, "when the Lord has set all things in order and brought them to completion." **11** "But what of the virgins?" I asked. "Must they remain with the tower always?" **12** "Until the tower is complete they shall be needed; but when it is complete, they shall depart and go away." **13** "And the angels who helped in building — shall they depart also?" **14** "They shall go," he said, "but first the tower shall be completed. Then all shall rejoice together in the presence of God."

---

*LOGOS: "no more unrighteousness found in the chosen people" is the completion-condition — the Church is complete when it is perfectly righteous. This is eschatological perfectionism.*
